title: If Morgan Rogers leaves Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
background: Morgan Rogers is an England international and an attacking player for Aston Villa.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official announcement from either club confirming a completed permanent transfer, corroborated by reputable sports reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Conditional on Rogers completing a permanent transfer away from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window, resolve to the acquiring club. If he completes multiple transfers during the window, use his first permanent transfer from Aston Villa. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the acquiring football club.
